doc.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019

title: Three years touring with Shearing
summary: He spent three years in the quintet, playing only two mallets, touring South America, Europe and the US; Rowe mentions Shearing's honorary degree.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So, and he was just phenomenal. And I was sort of wanting to experiment with four mallets and you only play two mallets with that band. I would hold four but I would only play the line. Sometimes with a solo you would occasionally play some chords, but I wasn’t anxious to go out.

I spent three years during that turn with him and we toured all over South America and all through Europe and all through the United States. We did community concert tours, sometimes three months at a clip where you’re out and you call a desk at the Holiday Inn and ask them what state you’re in. You just get really confused.
Wow. I’m happy to say he received an honorary degree here.
Yes, along with Joe Williams and a number of other musicians. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
